test_title: PYST 14: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Q is the brother of L. L is the sister of N. N is the father of R. R is married to P. P is the brother of T. T is the mother of X. Y is the daughter of R.

How is Y related to T?
solution:
Preparing the family tree diagram by using the following symbols:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f7c49c579fe5d0767e4437b66b4df91fbc86a3bd32f6fe6d69e9ce8322a78534.png] 

As per the given information:

1. Q is the brother of L, L is the sister of N and N is the father of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/12d625faf8d5ce730370c625c361c211ada15a8da769f11c0276e5b66586c334.png] 

2. R is married to P and P is the brother of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd527ff3f15be727577206fb401cf38dbfe4d50a390a7c9960cb218b1d903fe1.png] 

3. T is the mother of X and Y is the daughter of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4422a71881f92eb5dca06b6384269071e911bb81b84b482f3e829c9d65e438aa.png] 

Here, Y is the daughter of T's brother.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".
